args.code:
T1 = None
def control(obs):
    global T1
    t = obs.get('t', 0.0)
    v = obs.get('motion', {}).get('v_mps', 0.0)
    if T1 is None and v < -0.05:
        T1 = t
    h = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    target = -8.0 if (T1 is not None and t - T1 < 4.0) else 0.0
    steer = max(-30.0, min(30.0, 3.0 * (h - target)))
    return (steer, -0.6, 180)

T1 = None
def control(obs):
    global T1
    t = obs.get('t', 0.0)
    v = obs.get('motion', {}).get('v_mps', 0.0)
    if T1 is None and v < -0.05:
        T1 = t
    h = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    target = -8.0 if (T1 is not None and t - T1 < 4.0) else 0.0
    steer = max(-30.0, min(30.0, 3.0 * (h - target)))
    return (steer, -0.6, 180)
